releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.8.0 - Portal Theme Gallery + Enterprise Modernization
releaseNotes:
• 🎨 NEW: Portal Themes - 10 premium captive portal themes (Emerald Glass, Golden Buddha, Sunset Mandalay, Cyber Neon + 6 more) with one-tap deploy, auto price-list & SSID injection
• 🔧 FIXED: active-session crash (app no longer exits when tapping sessions)

• 💰 Revenue Hero dashboard
• ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This release carries the SAME signature as v1.6.3 - installs OVER it without uninstalling.
